label: A: Rainbow drop
desc: One big drop striped in the six potion colours, falling toward the rainbow brew.

label: B: Layered rainbow flask
desc: A round corked flask holding the brew in six clean colour layers.

label: C: Rainbow cauldron swirl
desc: An iron cauldron whose brew swirls in rainbow colours, coloured bubbles rising.

label: D: Rainbow bubbles
desc: Bubbles of every potion colour rising off the brew, one big shimmering bubble in front.

label: E: Pouring a rainbow
desc: A tipped vial pours the brew out as one stream in all six colours.

label: F: Spiral seen from above
desc: Looking down into a cauldron where the brew turns in a rainbow spiral round a bright centre.

label: G: Flask with rainbow vapour
desc: A conical flask of rainbow brew giving off a curling ribbon of rainbow vapour.

label: H: Ring of six drops
desc: Six drops, one in each potion colour, in a ring round a bright spark.
